goal: Den I143-Rastervorschlag gegen das aktuelle browserlokale Layout explizit als Vorher/Nachher-Vertrag darstellen. Jede geplante Zeilen- und Spaltenänderung wird sichtbar; tatsächliche Übernahme und Mutation bleiben gesperrt.

guide_delta.summary: I144 zeigt aktuelles Layout, vorgeschlagenes Layout und jede geplante Zeilen-/Spaltenänderung nebeneinander. Weil der Draft noch keine eigene Rasterzeile speichert, bleibt die Übernahme ausdrücklich gesperrt.

direct_dependencies: I143 read-only grid assistant is confirmed
existing renderDraft derives visual grid row from draft order
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: current layout exposes current derived row, column and width
proposal comparison exposes after row, column and width
planned row/column differences are explicit per draft element
draft order and widths remain unchanged
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because I144 is a browser-local comparison contract
real Chromium mutation evidence because no mutation path exists yet
risks: comparison could hide that row changes are currently not represented in the draft model
users could mistake a preview for an already applied layout
a future mutation path must not mutate only column while ignoring row
comparison logic must remain read-only and deterministic
non_changes: no column or width mutation from the assistant
no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
no new A-M product point completed
expected_side_effects: the user sees current and proposed layout side by side
the missing row-state contract is surfaced before mutation
